name: video_motion_shake
description: Adds handheld camera shake over one or more time windows. Each segment names its own window, style and intensity, so a clip can go calm → violent → calm in a single call. Segments must not be empty. Max 20s / 200 MB. Requires a paid plan. Then `creations_show`.

creationIdentifier.description: Completed owned video creation. Max 20s, 200 MB.

folderReference.description: From `folders_list`. Omit → the user's Personal project (refused if `disabled`). Does NOT persist: once the user names a target, pass it on EVERY later generation/edit call.

segments.description: One or more windows to shake. Untouched time stays steady.

end.description: Window end, in seconds. Must be after `start`.
